issues.title: Check that the page's markup is well-formed
issues.body:
Add a test that the page parses: every element is closed, in order. Run it from `check.sh`.

Holds for every site issue: every claim on the page is true on the day this merges, using the facts in `docs/status.md`; it reads at 390 px and at 1440 px.

## Technical decisions
None: a test inside the existing page and checks.

prs.title: Test that the page's markup is well-formed
prs.body:
Adds a test that every tag on the page is closed, in order, with a small parser over the standard library's HTMLParser.

Closes #4
